{{Quote
|We surely aren't seeing its finest moment, but this place has been serving us passing bugs for as long as any can remember. It's faith, you see! All those pilgrims, now and past. Our devotion holds it together. The camp'll remain, and provide, no matter the troubles.
|[[Pilby]]
|Hr=SS}}
<b>Bone Bottom</b> is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> containing the first town that can be encountered. It is part of the [[Mosslands]] alongside [[Moss Grotto]].

== Description ==
Bone Bottom is a small town that leads to [[the Marrow]]. It is inhabited by pilgrims, whose objective is to reach [[the Citadel]]. It is composed of tents and bone pieces.

Bone Bottom introduces the [[Wish]] system, with a [[Wishwall]] that gets continuously updated over the course of the game. The wishwall is maintained by [[Flick the Fixer]], and gets reconstructed after defeating the [[Bell Beast]]. The town also has a small shop owned by [[Pebb]], along with a Bellway Station. Inside the Station resides the [[Fearful Pilgrim]], who leaves the area after Hornet visits the town using the [[Bell Beast]]. The town has a bench, which [[Pilby]] will sit beside and talk to Hornet about various areas as she unlocks them. After certain game events, Pilby will leave his usual spot and be replaced by [[Quiet Pilgrim]].

== History ==
Bone Bottom features an old settlement formed by pilgrims of Pharloom. It has been serving passing bugs for as long as any can remember.<ref> Pilby dialogue:''"[…] But this place has been serving us passing bugs for as long as any can remember."''</ref> Bone Bottom is located within the peaceful [[Mosslands]] region, one of the only areas in [[Pharloom]] to be mostly untouched by [[the Citadel]]. 

Long ago a Chapel was built in Bone Bottom, possibly by the [[Snail Shamans]].<ref>[[Snail Shamans (Silksong)|Caretaker]]: <i>"Bound yourself a new nature, aye? And from the shells of our ancestors, no less, all those many who've called these lands their own."</i></ref> This chapel was a religious centre with a community dedicated to a faith completely different from [[Grand Mother Silk]]. After the construction of the Citadel, the members of this faith fled or went into hiding.<ref>{{HTalk|What duty binds you to this old chapel, madam? The structure barely stands, and I see no signs of congregation.}}<br>[[Chapel Maid]]: <i>Aye! Gone! The lot'o them, fled and hidden. But I'm not leaving till I've set this place right...<br>...It's that Citadel above, you see. Even now, in Pharloom's long decline, the simple bugs, they're witless before it. Too grand. Too majestic. Too powerful.<br>This building's state is a sad example of those who'd dare suggest another path...</i></ref> Eventually the chapel fell into ruins, leaving only the [[Chapel Maid]] left to maintain it. Bonegrave was a cemetery established in the west as a place to bury the dead inhabitants of Bone Bottom and pilgrims who couldn't make the climb.<ref><i>{{HTalk}} There is a vast grave beyond. I'd assume most bugs died climbing the path, but it seems many fell before their trek had barely commenced?</i><br>[[Chapel Maid]]: <i>Aye! Lost their lives to beasts, or to luck turned rotten. Others were simply formed too frail. At least those poor souls can rest together.</i></ref>

Mosshome was another settlement to the northeast, and served as a place of rest and healing for passing pilgrims.<ref name="moss"><i>[[Lore Tablets (Silksong)|Lore Tablet]]: "Weaver of Pharloom. By grace you warded. By thread you healed. For your favour, eternal, we offer our song."</i></ref> Eventually it too fell into ruin because of the [[Haunting]]. Mosshome is also the [[Weaver Burial Spire|burial site]] of a [[Weavers|Weaver]], presumably Camora, Weaver of Healing, as her effigy is also found nearby.<ref> [[Weaver Effigy]] (Found in Bone Bottom):<i>"Carving of Camora, Weaver of the path. A prayer is etched upon it."</i></ref><ref name="moss"/> 

== How to Access ==
Bone Bottom can be accessed by climbing through the [[Ruined Chapel]] after defeating the [[Moss Mother]].

<b>Mosshome</b> is a ruined settlement above the town of Bone Bottom. It is built around the [[Weaver Burial Spire|burial spire]] of a [[Weaver]] who warded and healed its inhabitants with her [[Silk|thread]], earning their reverence.<ref>[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] dialogue with [[Pilby]]: <i>"I've visited the settlement you speak of. It was built around a burial spire, corpse-home to an ancient Weaver."</i></ref><ref>[[Lore_Tablets_(Silksong)#Bone_Bottom|Lore Tablet]] near the burial spire: <i>"Weaver of Pharloom. By grace you warded. By thread you healed. For your favour, eternal, we offer our song."</i></ref> This Weaver may be [[Weavers#Notable_Weavers|Camora, Weaver of healing]], as an effigy to her can be found near Mosshome.<ref>[[Weaver Effigy]]: <i>"Carving of Camora, Weaver of healing. A prayer is etched upon it. 'Weaver, heal my sons, their fearful hearts, their limbs that shake at the climb to come. We pray, gift but a glimmer of your strength, that when we stand before your divinity, you see bugs shed free of fear.'"</i></ref>

The Weavers introduced the bugs of Mosshome to the religion of [[the Citadel]] and persuaded them to make pilgrimage to it.<ref>A [[:File:Screenshot SS Pilgrim Groveller 01.png|statue]] of the Citadel symbol and several [[:File:Screenshot SS Rosary Shrine Moss.png|Rosary shrines]] can be seen in Mosshome.</ref><ref>[[Lore_Tablets_(Silksong)#Bone_Bottom|Lore Tablet]] near the burial spire: <i>"Sister, spider, husk bound to moss, Watch over these bugs born low, Raised up by fervour fostered, Born and caught within our web unknowing."</i></ref><ref>[[Mask Maker (Silksong)|Mask Maker]]: <i>"Devised by your ancestors that monstrosity, and their wicked, clever minds. A system, or a web they'd likely call it, a way to keep their mother sealed in slumber, and themselves free to lavish in their false rule."</i></ref> Some of the pilgrims of Bone Bottom believe that Mosshome is a holy and safe place.<ref>Pilby: <i>"Must be terrifying out there, beyond the settlement. Nothing but monsters and madness lurking in the darkness. I've heard tales of a safe place, though. Just up above here, where the moss paints the stones green, there's an old village. Bit of a holy place, apparently, well protected."</i></ref>

Mosshome is first accessible from [[the Marrow]]. At the very top, the [[Silkspear]] skill can be acquired, which is necessary for reaching the [[Moss Druid]] residing in a cave in the top right of the area, as well as freeing the [[Bell Beast]].

<b>Bonegrave</b> is a vast graveyard beyond the [[Ruined Chapel]], where fallen pilgrims are buried.<ref>Hornet and [[Chapel Maid]] dialogue:<br><i>Hornet: "There is a vast grave beyond. I'd assumed most bugs died climbing the path, but it seems many fell before their trek had barely commenced."<br>Chapel Maid: "Aye! Lost their lives to beasts, or to luck turned rotten. Others were simply formed too frail. At least those poor souls can rest together. Death and death and death, the eternal promise of our eternal kingdom. Eventually, it claims us all."</i></ref><ref> Bonegrave [[Needolin]] dialogue: <i>"...Not worthy... ...Alone, without you... ...Climb and serve... ...Die and serve..."</i></ref> It can be accessed from the [[Wormways]] after opening the [[Simple Key (Silksong)|Simple Key]] door, or from above the Ruined Chapel with [[Cling Grip]].

After the [[Wanderer Crest]] is obtained from the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]], pilgrims will start to spawn from the graves around the chapel when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] gets near. There are three possible enemy spawn variants that change after resting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]]:

At the start of [[Act 3]], a [[Covetous Pilgrim]] appears outside the chapel, taking the place of the normal enemies. Random spawns resume once the Covetous Pilgrim is killed. Hanging blue vines and a [[Plasmium Cocoon]] also appear, hinting at the transformation that has taken place in the Wormways.

{{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} In [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], an extra room appears here during the <i>[[A Vassal Lost]]</i> [[wish]], containing [[Sula]] and the [[Summoned Saviour]] boss.

The <b>Chapel of the Wanderer</b> is a mausoleum located in Bonegrave. [[Rosaries]] can be found here lying on the ground or hanging on strings, but the path to them is riddled with traps. Further below is an [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Bone Bottom|enemy gauntlet]], and upon completing it, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can find and bind a corpse to obtain the [[Wanderer Crest]]. After binding the crest and leaving the sub-area, the door closes permanently.

== Creation and Development ==
{{Main|Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Bone Bottom}}
[[File:Mosshome April 2021.png|thumb|220px|Mosshome in April 2021]]
Formerly spelt "Bonebottom", Bone Bottom was conceptualised around February 2019, with the town's layout remaining relatively unchanged since its conception. The layout of the town appeared on earlier maps as part of the "[[Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Bonechurch|Bonechurch]]" area. The [[Cut Content (Silksong)/NPCs#Caravantula|Caravantula]] NPC would have also appeared in the town. The town was showcased in the February 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer,<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref>  and its theme was released in December 2019.<ref>[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/11xf7azcuebhybgossfhdc0mphiqbs/ Team Cherry Blog Post] of December 13th, 2019.</ref> In June 2019, a screenshot of the town's right-side was released in a [[Team Cherry]] blog post, featuring Flick the Fixer working on a Wishwall. It showcases the same layout as the final game, but with darker visuals.<ref>[https://www.teamcherry.com.au/blog/post-e3-wrap-silksong-systems-update Team Cherry blog post] of June 25th, 2019</ref>

The primary changes throughout development were in the sub-area Mosshome. It used to be double in size, with a large portion of eastern rooms which connected it to the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] passage between [[the Marrow]] and [[Shellwood]]. These rooms were removed following the April 2021 map. A second [[Craggler]] could be found in the room just south of the [[Weaver Burial Spire]], it appears to be removed post-September 2021. Additionally, at some point, cut [[Aknid]] eggs were planned to appear in the eastern bench room; they likely had the ability to hatch.<ref><code>collectorEggsHatched</code></ref> Like the town, Mosshome was seen in the reveal trailer, being the focus of multiple clips.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref>
